situation (example wording): "Compare violent crime to number of police officers in Kansas City in 2022 vs 2025" (staffing and a crime in one question)
what the app does today: Declined: a staffing question with a crime is not read as staffing.
proposed behavior: Declined in plain words: the app answers one dataset at a time, so staffing and a crime can't be in the same question. exact default or choices offered: None: staffing and crime are asked separately.
why: Jeff: the app should do one dataset at a time, not mix them.
